text: Mathematics is a fundamental discipline that studies quantity, structure, change and spatial models. Through abstraction and logical reasoning, it explores patterns and serves as the theoretical foundation and tool for natural sciences, engineering technology, social sciences and other fields. It is not only the "language" for describing the laws of the universe, but also the core force driving technological breakthroughs (such as cryptography and artificial intelligence algorithms) and solving practical problems (such as economic forecasting and climate simulation).
